target.configuration_scope: existing Hello/VADD functional baseline; custom instruction not built or run

encoding.neighbor_rule: other funct3/funct6 values are not this vdot; use normal ISA dispatch, illegal only if unallocated

semantics.mask_rule: when vm=0, old_v0 bit i selects source product i; vm=1 ignores mask, but v0 may still be an explicit data source
semantics.vl_zero: preserve entire vd; successful vector context completion still marks VS Dirty
semantics.vl_8_to_16: reduce exactly first eight source pairs; ignore source indices 8..15
semantics.all_masked_off_nonzero_vl: write zero to all 128 destination bits
semantics.vta_vma: both flag values accepted; custom whole-result policy overrides generic destination merging on nonzero-vl success
semantics.source_destination_overlap: all single-register overlaps allowed, including masked vd=v0; snapshot sources and mask before destination update

csr_success.vector_context_status: mark mstatus.VS Dirty on every legal completion including vl=0; when virtualized mark vsstatus.VS Dirty too; SD follows architectural derivation

ordered_operation: If encoding does not match, do not execute this specification; continue normal ISA decode.
Require target vector extension enabled and vector context available; when virtualized require both host and guest vector contexts.
Reject vill=1 or illegal/reserved vtype, SEW!=8 or LMUL!=1.
Reject vstart!=0 before the vl=0 path.
Reject vl not equal to zero and not in [8,16].
If vl=0 preserve all vector registers, complete with vstart=0 and the specified VS Dirty rule.
Snapshot old vs1, vs2 and, only when vm=0, old v0 mask.
Sum the selected signed source products at indices 0..7 in exact precision from zero.
Write sum modulo 2^32 into vd bits31:0 and zero bits127:32; complete with vstart=0 and VS Dirty.
